lead.headline: 16 House members running for Senate doubled their missed votes in campaign season, but did the same two years earlier
lead.number: Median missed rate 1.8% (Jan-Nov 2025) to 3.5% (Dec 2025-Jun 2026), other members flat; the same 16 rose 0.3% to 2.4% in the same months of 2023-24
lead.watch_out: The placebo kills the cause: net of the same 16's rise two years earlier, the gap is not significant, and the menu says drop it.
